History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headaches are associated with some nausea.
Patient denies vomiting with the headaches.
Patient has no prior medical history of headaches.
Patient reports reduced appetite with an unintentional weight loss of 5 lbs.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Reduced appetite, with unintentional weight loss, loss of 5lbs

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experiences pins and needles in both arms without radiation to the legs.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Pins and needles in both arms, no radiation to legs

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Despite tingling, motor and sensory function are maintained with no loss of function.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations are associated with mild shortness of breath on exertion and at rest.
